Each NAME.json is the stdout of `atlc run examples/NAME.toml` and NAME.args the args of `atlc spec examples/NAME.toml --json` (one per line, the examples directory written @EXAMPLES@), from atlc 3f9ce62 against algotradelib 7b16b00.
To re-record after atlc's examples, its report or the library's report change: run those two commands again with an atlc that still has them (3f9ce62) and the library, and write each output over its file, the examples directory replaced by @EXAMPLES@.
